note: 店长手写层。此文件覆盖同 id 抓取项的任意字段；每次 feed 重建时合并，scout 永远不会覆盖这里的内容。

juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 像原始人一样说话：「为什么用很多 token，少 token 就行」。
juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.tagline_en: Claude talks caveman: "why use many token when few token do trick."
juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.why_zh: 一个玩笑做成了真产品：token 账单实打实地降（据称 65%），还顺手治好了 AI 的啰嗦病。
juliusbrussee-caveman-caveman.why_en: A joke that became a product — real token savings (claimed 65%), and it cures verbosity as a side effect.

worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.tagline_zh: 喂给它一本小说，它按原著设定拆世界观、出美术方向、直接把游戏做出来——真的能玩。
worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.tagline_en: Feed it a novel; it extracts the world, art-directs it, and builds a genuinely playable game grounded in the source text.
worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.why_zh: 「把喜欢的小说做成能玩的游戏」是很多人的童年梦想，这个 skill 把整条流水线打包好了，交给 Claude Code 就能开工。
worldwonderer-novel-to-game-novel-to-gam.why_en: Turning a beloved book into a playable game is a childhood dream for a lot of people — this packages the whole pipeline so Claude Code can just get to work.

worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.tagline_zh: 网文工业流水线：扫榜、拆文、长短篇写作、去 AI 味、封面图，13 件全流程。
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.tagline_en: A web-fiction production line: chart-scanning, deconstruction, writing, de-AI-flavoring, covers — 13 pieces.
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.why_zh: 中文互联网最生猛的 skill 包之一：不是教你写作，是直接把网文生产线搬进 Claude Code。
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode.why_en: One of the most ambitious packs on the Chinese internet — it installs the production line, not writing tips.

alchaincyf-huashu-design.tagline_zh: 花叔出品：一句需求，产出高保真 HTML 原型、幻灯片和动画。
alchaincyf-huashu-design.tagline_en: From Huashu: one request in, hi-fi HTML prototypes, slides and motion out.
alchaincyf-huashu-design.why_zh: 中文社区口碑最好的设计 skill：不只给样式，还给审美立场——附赠的 20 条设计哲学正是大多数 AI 页面缺的东西。
alchaincyf-huashu-design.why_en: The Chinese community's best-loved design skill — it ships a point of view (20 design principles), not just styles.

anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.tagline_zh: 说一句「来点赛博山水」，看它现场写 p5.js 给你画出来。
anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.tagline_en: Say "cyber landscape" and watch it write p5.js that paints one, live.
anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.why_zh: 官方 skill 里最好玩的一个：流场、粒子、种子随机都封装好了，体验的是「AI 亲手作画」，不是调图库。
anthropics-skills-algorithmic-art.why_en: The most playful official skill — flow fields, particles and seeded randomness pre-wired; real generative art, not stock images.

anthropics-skills-slack-gif-creator.tagline_zh: 给团队 Slack 造专属 GIF 表情，程序化生成不求人。
anthropics-skills-slack-gif-creator.tagline_en: Custom Slack GIFs, generated programmatically on demand.
anthropics-skills-slack-gif-creator.why_zh: 用代码逐帧作画再合成 GIF 的思路很妙，改几个参数就是自家的梗图流水线。
anthropics-skills-slack-gif-creator.why_en: Draws frames in code, then assembles the GIF — tweak a few params and it's your meme pipeline.

leonxlnx-taste-skill.tagline_zh: 往你的 agent 里注入「品味」：设计、审美、克制，三件套。
leonxlnx-taste-skill.tagline_en: Inject taste into your agent: design sense, restraint, judgment.
leonxlnx-taste-skill.why_zh: 它赌品味可以被写下来——那份审美守则读完你会点头，装完输出确实不土了。
leonxlnx-taste-skill.why_en: Bets that taste can be written down. Read its rules and you'll nod; install it and outputs stop looking cheap.

blader-humanizer.tagline_zh: 一键去 AI 味：删掉「值得注意的是」和排比腔，像人写的。
blader-humanizer.tagline_en: Strip the AI-isms — no more "it's worth noting", no triple parallelism.
blader-humanizer.why_zh: 34k 星不是白来的：它列的「AI 写作臭味清单」极其具体，反过来读就是一堂写作课。
blader-humanizer.why_en: 34k stars earned — its catalog of AI writing smells is so specific it doubles as a writing course.

aldegad-sprite-gen.tagline_zh: 一句话出一套干净的 2D 精灵图：状态行、透明底、逐帧拆好。
aldegad-sprite-gen.tagline_en: One line, one clean sprite sheet — state rows, alpha, frames split.
aldegad-sprite-gen.why_zh: 游戏素材是独立开发最大的坑之一，它把「画小人」变成了一句话的事，产物直接进引擎。
aldegad-sprite-gen.why_en: Art is indie dev's biggest wall; this turns "draw me a sprite" into a one-liner with engine-ready output.

vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.tagline_zh: 用 Remotion 拍电影感产品视频：106 张分镜配方卡，一句话出片。
vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.tagline_en: Cinematic product videos via Remotion — 106 shot recipes, one prompt to film.
vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.why_zh: 把「拍产品宣传片」这种要外包的活变成了本地技能，分镜卡的设计尤其讲究。
vincentwei1021-video-shotcraft.why_en: Turns "hire a studio" into a local skill; the shot recipe cards are unusually well crafted.

dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.tagline_zh: 请一位「躺平但靠谱」的资深工程师进驻：能不写的代码绝不写。
dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.tagline_en: An unbothered senior engineer moves in: writes no code that needn't exist.
dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.why_zh: 反内卷的工程精髓——它总在问「这真的需要做吗」，治过度设计比写代码更省钱。
dietrichgebert-ponytail-ponytail.why_en: Its favorite question is "do we even need this?" — killing overengineering saves more than writing code.

ayghri-i-have-adhd-i-have-adhd.tagline_zh: 给 ADHD 大脑定制的相处模式：短句、一次一件事、绝不啰嗦。
ayghri-i-have-adhd-i-have-adhd.tagline_en: Claude tuned for ADHD brains: short lines, one thing at a time, zero rambling.
ayghri-i-have-adhd-i-have-adhd.why_zh: 少见的认真对待神经多样性的 skill，交互约束写得很体贴；非 ADHD 用户拿来治 AI 话痨也好用。
ayghri-i-have-adhd-i-have-adhd.why_en: A rare skill that takes neurodivergence seriously — and its anti-rambling rules help everyone.

tracywang95-anythingbutlaw.tagline_zh: 合同、条款、律师函——让它翻成人话，再决定签不签。
tracywang95-anythingbutlaw.tagline_en: Contracts and legalese, translated into plain speech before you sign.
tracywang95-anythingbutlaw.why_zh: 不装律师，只做「看懂」这一件事：逐条解释加风险点标注，普通人签字前过一遍很安心。
tracywang95-anythingbutlaw.why_en: Doesn't play lawyer — just makes you understand: clause-by-clause explanation with flagged risks.

jimliu-baoyu-skills.tagline_zh: 宝玉老师的日常工具箱：翻译、配图、漫画、图表，一次打包。
jimliu-baoyu-skills.tagline_en: Baoyu's daily toolbox — translation, illustrations, comics, diagrams, bundled.
jimliu-baoyu-skills.why_zh: 中文 AI 圈最勤快的实践者之一，每件都是他自己天天在用的东西，密度极高。
jimliu-baoyu-skills.why_en: From one of the most prolific practitioners in the Chinese AI scene — tools he actually uses daily.

jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-comic.tagline_zh: 把一段观点画成四格或条漫，宝玉同款画风。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-comic.tagline_en: Turn an argument into a four-panel comic, Baoyu-style.
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-comic.why_zh: 分镜和台词的提示词打磨得很细，出图有叙事感，不是贴图拼盘。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-comic.why_en: Carefully tuned paneling and dialogue prompts — the output tells a story, not a collage.

jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-diagram.tagline_zh: 文字进，示意图出：流程、架构、对比图都行。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-diagram.tagline_en: Text in, diagrams out — flows, architectures, comparisons.
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-diagram.why_zh: 图的信息密度控制得好，是「能放进正式文档」的那种图。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-diagram.why_en: Information density done right — diagrams you can ship in real docs.

jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-image-gen.tagline_zh: 宝玉调教过的配图提示词，出图自带编辑部审美。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-image-gen.tagline_en: Baoyu-tuned image prompts with an editor's eye baked in.
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-image-gen.why_zh: 省掉自己试提示词的几十轮迭代，那份风格词表本身就值得收藏。
jimliu-baoyu-skills-baoyu-image-gen.why_en: Skips your dozens of prompt iterations; the style vocabulary alone is worth keeping.

anthropics-skills-canvas-design.tagline_zh: 不开 Figma，直接让 Claude 出海报级的视觉稿。
anthropics-skills-canvas-design.tagline_en: Poster-grade visuals straight from Claude, no Figma session needed.
anthropics-skills-canvas-design.why_zh: 官方演示「设计品味可以写进提示词」的样本：配色、排版约束写得极细，值得抄作业。
anthropics-skills-canvas-design.why_en: An official proof that taste can be written down — its color and layout constraints are worth stealing.

anthropics-skills-theme-factory.tagline_zh: 一句话生成整套配色主题，页面气质当场换血。
anthropics-skills-theme-factory.tagline_en: One line in, a full color theme out — instant personality transplant.
anthropics-skills-theme-factory.why_zh: 产出的是结构化 design tokens 而不是一张灵感图，能直接落进代码，这点比配色网站实用。
anthropics-skills-theme-factory.why_en: Outputs structured design tokens, not a mood image — drops straight into code.

anthropics-skills-frontend-design.tagline_zh: 专治 AI 生成页面那股一眼假的「模板味」。
anthropics-skills-frontend-design.tagline_en: The cure for that instantly-recognizable AI template look.
anthropics-skills-frontend-design.why_zh: 一整套设计令牌和排版纪律，让输出有主见：字体、留白、层级全是硬约束，不是口号。
anthropics-skills-frontend-design.why_en: Design tokens plus typographic discipline as hard constraints — opinionated output, not vibes.

anthropics-skills-brand-guidelines.tagline_zh: 把品牌规范喂给它，从此每份产出都不跑偏。
anthropics-skills-brand-guidelines.tagline_en: Feed it your brand book; every output stays on-brand after that.
anthropics-skills-brand-guidelines.why_zh: 价值在示范：教你把「品牌一致性」写成机器能执行的规则，照抄结构就能做自家版本。
anthropics-skills-brand-guidelines.why_en: A worked example of encoding brand consistency as executable rules — copy the structure for your own brand.

anthropics-skills-docx.tagline_zh: 产出带目录、页眉、样式的正经 Word，不是贴纯文本。
anthropics-skills-docx.tagline_en: Real Word files — TOC, headers, styles — not pasted plain text.
anthropics-skills-docx.why_zh: 官方文档四件套之一：修订、模板这些脏活的处理代码都写好了，生产可用级别。
anthropics-skills-docx.why_en: One of the official doc four-pack; tracked changes and templates handled, production-ready.

anthropics-skills-pdf.tagline_zh: 合并、拆分、填表单、加水印——PDF 的脏活一句话搞定。
anthropics-skills-pdf.tagline_en: Merge, split, fill forms, watermark — PDF drudgery in one sentence.
anthropics-skills-pdf.why_zh: 底层库的坑（编码、表单字段、扫描件）都替你踩过了，是四件套里出场率最高的。
anthropics-skills-pdf.why_en: Encoding quirks and form-field traps already solved; the workhorse of the doc four-pack.

anthropics-skills-pptx.tagline_zh: 一句需求，产出能直接开会用的 PPT 文件。
anthropics-skills-pptx.tagline_en: One request in, a deck you can actually present out.
anthropics-skills-pptx.why_zh: 不止生成内容：版式、母版、图表都按规范来，是「AI 做 PPT」里少见的可交付级别。
anthropics-skills-pptx.why_en: Layouts, masters and charts done properly — rare deliverable-grade AI slides.

anthropics-skills-xlsx.tagline_zh: 读得懂、也写得出带公式和格式的 Excel，不是导出 CSV 糊弄。
anthropics-skills-xlsx.tagline_en: Reads and writes real Excel — formulas and formatting, not a CSV cop-out.
anthropics-skills-xlsx.why_zh: 表格是办公场景的硬通货：它连公式重算、格式套用这类细节都处理了，四件套里最容易被低估的一个。
anthropics-skills-xlsx.why_en: Spreadsheets are office hard currency; it handles formula recalc and formatting — the most underrated of the four-pack.

anthropics-skills-skill-creator.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 自己写 skill 的 skill——套娃，但真有用。
anthropics-skills-skill-creator.tagline_en: The skill that writes skills. Recursive, and genuinely useful.
anthropics-skills-skill-creator.why_zh: 把写 skill 的最佳实践（触发词、结构、反例）固化成流程，是整个生态的元工具：想做自己的 skill，先装它。
anthropics-skills-skill-creator.why_en: Best practices for triggers, structure and anti-patterns, baked in — the meta-tool of this whole ecosystem.

nidhinjs-prompt-master.tagline_zh: 把你的糙 prompt 重写成专业级：结构、示例、边界一次补齐。
nidhinjs-prompt-master.tagline_en: Rewrites your rough prompt into a pro one — structure, examples, edge cases.
nidhinjs-prompt-master.why_zh: 相当于内置一位提示词工程师；改完的 prompt 复用价值高，适合沉淀成团队词库。
nidhinjs-prompt-master.why_en: A prompt engineer on call; the rewrites are reusable enough to seed a team library.

obra-superpowers.tagline_zh: 给 Claude Code 装上「超能力」全家桶：风暴、分身、按计划施工。
obra-superpowers.tagline_en: Superpowers for Claude Code: brainstorms, parallel agents, plan-driven work.
obra-superpowers.why_zh: 作者 obra 是老牌开源人，这套把 agent 工作流方法论做成了可安装的零件，是生态里被借鉴最多的仓库之一。
obra-superpowers.why_en: By veteran open-sourcer obra — agent-workflow methodology as installable parts; one of the most-imitated repos around.

obra-superpowers-brainstorming.tagline_zh: 强制发散：一次给你二十个方向，先量后质。
obra-superpowers-brainstorming.tagline_en: Forced divergence: twenty directions first, judgment later.
obra-superpowers-brainstorming.why_zh: 流程里带「禁止过早收敛」的纪律，比自己干想有效得多。
obra-superpowers-brainstorming.why_en: Bakes in a no-premature-convergence rule — beats staring at a blank page.

addyosmani-agent-skills.tagline_zh: Chrome 团队 Addy Osmani 的私藏工具箱，一次全部带走。
addyosmani-agent-skills.tagline_en: Addy Osmani's (Chrome team) personal toolbox, in one grab.
addyosmani-agent-skills.why_zh: 作者是写过多本前端名著的谷歌工程负责人，工程口味极正：每件都短、准、能落地。
addyosmani-agent-skills.why_en: From the Google engineering lead behind several classic frontend books — short, sharp, immediately usable.

coreyhaines31-marketingskills.tagline_zh: 营销人的全套家伙：定位、落地页、邮件序列、投放复盘。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills.tagline_en: A marketer's full kit: positioning, landing pages, email sequences, ad reviews.
coreyhaines31-marketingskills.why_zh: 作者做 SaaS 营销出身，套路来自实操而非教科书；拿来直接产出物料，不是听课。
coreyhaines31-marketingskills.why_en: Built by a SaaS marketing practitioner — it produces assets, not lectures.

donchitos-claude-code-game-studios.tagline_zh: 一个人 + Claude Code = 一间游戏工作室：策划、美术、程序全包。
donchitos-claude-code-game-studios.tagline_en: You + Claude Code = a game studio: design, art, code, all covered.
donchitos-claude-code-game-studios.why_zh: 把游戏开发拆成可指挥的流水线角色，独立开发者照着走真能出 demo，野心和完成度都在线。
donchitos-claude-code-game-studios.why_en: Splits gamedev into commandable roles; solo devs actually ship demos with it.

geekjourneyx-md2wechat-skill-md2wechat.tagline_zh: Markdown 一键排成微信公众号格式，样式不再崩。
geekjourneyx-md2wechat-skill-md2wechat.tagline_en: Markdown to WeChat-official-account layout in one shot, styles intact.
geekjourneyx-md2wechat-skill-md2wechat.why_zh: 被公众号编辑器折磨过的人都懂：它把内联样式这种脏活全自动化了，中文创作者刚需。
geekjourneyx-md2wechat-skill-md2wechat.why_en: Automates the inline-style misery of WeChat's editor — a must for Chinese creators.

agents365-ai-drawio-skill-drawio-skill.tagline_zh: 说清楚架构，它直接产出可编辑的 draw.io 源文件。
agents365-ai-drawio-skill-drawio-skill.tagline_en: Describe the architecture; get an editable .drawio file back.
agents365-ai-drawio-skill-drawio-skill.why_zh: 输出是真源文件而不是截图，画完还能自己拖着改——这是它和「AI 画图」最大的区别。
agents365-ai-drawio-skill-drawio-skill.why_en: Real source files, not screenshots — you keep editing after it draws. That's the difference.

leonxlnx-taste-skill-image-to-code.tagline_zh: 丢一张截图，还原成有品味的代码，而不是像素堆。
leonxlnx-taste-skill-image-to-code.tagline_en: Drop a screenshot, get tasteful code back — not a pixel dump.
leonxlnx-taste-skill-image-to-code.why_zh: 难点在还原「设计意图」而非像素级复刻，它在这个取舍上做得很聪明。
leonxlnx-taste-skill-image-to-code.why_en: Recovers design intent rather than chasing pixel parity — the smart trade-off.

leonxlnx-taste-skill-design-taste-fronte.tagline_zh: 前端专用品味包：字距、留白、层级的洁癖清单。
leonxlnx-taste-skill-design-taste-fronte.tagline_en: Frontend taste, itemized: tracking, whitespace, hierarchy.
leonxlnx-taste-skill-design-taste-fronte.why_zh: 把「看起来贵」拆成可执行规则，照着改三处，页面气质就不一样。
leonxlnx-taste-skill-design-taste-fronte.why_en: Decomposes "looks expensive" into executable rules — change three things and feel the difference.

worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode-story-.tagline_zh: 网文封面一键出图：书名字效、氛围、平台规范它都懂。
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode-story-.tagline_en: Web-novel covers in one go — title lettering, mood, platform specs included.
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode-story-.why_zh: 对主流平台的封面套路研究得很透，出的图真能直接上架用。
worldwonderer-oh-story-claudecode-story-.why_en: Studies platform cover conventions closely enough that outputs are upload-ready.

anthropics-skills-claude-api.tagline_zh: 接 Claude API 不用翻文档，直接问它怎么写。
anthropics-skills-claude-api.tagline_en: Integrate the Claude API without tab-hopping through docs.
anthropics-skills-claude-api.why_zh: 官方自己维护的 API 知识，比过期博客靠谱；写集成代码时少踩版本和参数的坑。
anthropics-skills-claude-api.why_en: API knowledge maintained by the vendor itself — fewer stale-blog mistakes, fewer version traps.

anthropics-skills-mcp-builder.tagline_zh: 想给 Claude 接自家系统？它手把手带你写出一个 MCP server。
anthropics-skills-mcp-builder.tagline_en: Hook Claude to your own systems — it walks you through building an MCP server.
anthropics-skills-mcp-builder.why_zh: 官方出品的 MCP 教练：脚手架、调试、协议细节全包，比自己啃 spec 快一个下午。
anthropics-skills-mcp-builder.why_en: The official MCP coach — scaffolding, debugging and protocol detail included; faster than reading the spec.

anthropics-skills-webapp-testing.tagline_zh: 让 Claude 开真浏览器把你的网页点一遍，替你找茬。
anthropics-skills-webapp-testing.tagline_en: Claude drives a real browser through your app and files the bugs.
anthropics-skills-webapp-testing.why_zh: 基于 Playwright 的自动巡检：选择器、等待策略这些最烦人的细节官方都封装好了。
anthropics-skills-webapp-testing.why_en: Playwright-based checks with the annoying parts — selectors, waits — already handled.

anthropics-skills-web-artifacts-builder.tagline_zh: 在 Claude 里直接搭能交互的网页小应用。
anthropics-skills-web-artifacts-builder.tagline_en: Build interactive web mini-apps right inside Claude.
anthropics-skills-web-artifacts-builder.why_zh: 把 artifacts 环境的隐藏规则（存储、可用库、限制）都写明白了，能少走很多弯路。
anthropics-skills-web-artifacts-builder.why_en: Documents the artifact environment's hidden rules — storage, allowed libs, limits — so you stop guessing.

anthropics-skills-internal-comms.tagline_zh: 周报、公告、全员信，一分钟出「得体」的那一版。
anthropics-skills-internal-comms.tagline_en: Status updates and announcements that land right, in one pass.
anthropics-skills-internal-comms.why_zh: 模板不是套话合集，是把「说清楚 + 不惹事」的内部沟通分寸编码了进去。
anthropics-skills-internal-comms.why_en: Not boilerplate — it encodes the actual judgment of clear, low-drama internal comms.

anthropics-skills-doc-coauthoring.tagline_zh: 不是替你写文档，是陪你一段一段把文档磨出来。
anthropics-skills-doc-coauthoring.tagline_en: It doesn't write your doc for you — it co-writes it, section by section.
anthropics-skills-doc-coauthoring.why_zh: 把「共创」拆成提问→草稿→逐段确认的流程，治好 AI 一口气生成一篇假大空的毛病。
anthropics-skills-doc-coauthoring.why_en: Turns co-writing into ask → draft → confirm loops, curing the one-shot wall-of-fluff habit.

addyosmani-agent-skills-api-and-interfac.tagline_zh: 设计 API 前先让它过一遍：命名、错误、版本一次到位。
addyosmani-agent-skills-api-and-interfac.tagline_en: Run your API past it first — naming, errors, versioning, sorted.
addyosmani-agent-skills-api-and-interfac.why_zh: 浓缩了大厂 API review 里最常见的那些意见，等于随身带一位严格的接口评审人。
addyosmani-agent-skills-api-and-interfac.why_en: Condenses the recurring feedback of big-co API reviews into a pocket reviewer.

addyosmani-agent-skills-browser-testing-.tagline_zh: 让 agent 自己驱动 DevTools：性能、内存、网络一条龙排查。
addyosmani-agent-skills-browser-testing-.tagline_en: The agent drives DevTools itself — perf, memory, network, end to end.
addyosmani-agent-skills-browser-testing-.why_zh: 不是教你开 F12，是让 AI 拿着协议接口自己抓证据，调性能时特别省事。
addyosmani-agent-skills-browser-testing-.why_en: Not "open F12" advice — the AI gathers evidence via the protocol itself. Great for perf hunts.

addyosmani-agent-skills-ci-cd-and-automa.tagline_zh: 把 CI/CD 十年老坑写成一册避雷手册。
addyosmani-agent-skills-ci-cd-and-automa.tagline_en: A decade of CI/CD scar tissue, written down as a field guide.
addyosmani-agent-skills-ci-cd-and-automa.why_zh: 从缓存策略到 flaky test 治理都是具体招数，照着做能省掉大量试错。
addyosmani-agent-skills-ci-cd-and-automa.why_en: Concrete moves — cache strategy, flaky-test triage — that skip you past the usual trial and error.

obra-superpowers-executing-plans.tagline_zh: 先立计划再动手，每步打钩，跑偏自动拉回。
obra-superpowers-executing-plans.tagline_en: Plan first, then execute — checkboxes per step, drift auto-corrected.
obra-superpowers-executing-plans.why_zh: 治 agent「写着写着忘了目标」的老毛病，长任务成功率肉眼可见地涨。
obra-superpowers-executing-plans.why_en: Cures the mid-task amnesia problem; long-task success rates visibly climb.

obra-superpowers-dispatching-parallel-ag.tagline_zh: 把大任务拆给多个并行分身，各干各的再汇总。
obra-superpowers-dispatching-parallel-ag.tagline_en: Split the job across parallel agents, then merge the results.
obra-superpowers-dispatching-parallel-ag.why_zh: 任务切分与回收的协议写得很清楚，是学 multi-agent 编排的好范本。
obra-superpowers-dispatching-parallel-ag.why_en: Clean dispatch-and-collect protocol — a solid template for multi-agent orchestration.

worldwonderer-novel-to-game.tagline_zh: 喂它一本小说，按原著拆世界观、出美术方向，直接把游戏做出来——真的能玩。
worldwonderer-novel-to-game.tagline_en: Feed it a novel; it extracts the world, art-directs it, and ships a playable game.
worldwonderer-novel-to-game.why_zh: 「把喜欢的小说做成能玩的游戏」是很多人的童年梦想，这个 skill 把整条流水线打包好了，交给 Claude Code 就能开工。
worldwonderer-novel-to-game.why_en: Turning a beloved book into a playable game is a childhood dream — this packages the whole pipeline.

specstoryai-getspecstory-lore.tagline_zh: 把你散落各处的 AI 编程会话，挖成一部可检索的「项目正史」。
specstoryai-getspecstory-lore.tagline_en: Mines your scattered AI coding sessions into a searchable project lore.
specstoryai-getspecstory-lore.why_zh: 思路很妙：你和 agent 的聊天记录本身就是资产，它负责把这堆金矿筛出有证据、可复用的工作流。
specstoryai-getspecstory-lore.why_en: Your agent transcripts are an asset; this sifts the gold — reproducible workflows with receipts.

specstoryai-getspecstory-workthreads.tagline_zh: 把全组一周的 AI 编程会话，自动卷成「谁在干什么」的线索周报。
specstoryai-getspecstory-workthreads.tagline_en: Rolls a team's week of AI coding sessions into who's-doing-what threads.
specstoryai-getspecstory-workthreads.why_zh: 管理者视角的好东西：不数代码行，看真实工作线程，周会材料自动就有了。
specstoryai-getspecstory-workthreads.why_en: A manager's tool that counts threads of real work, not lines of code — standup material writes itself.

wondelai-skills.tagline_zh: 商业、营销、UX 畅销书里的经典框架，做成 50 件即装即用的 skill。
wondelai-skills.tagline_en: Classic frameworks from business, marketing and UX bestsellers — 50 installable skills.
wondelai-skills.why_zh: 「读过书」和「用上书」之间差的那一步它替你做了：每个框架都带引导式流程，不是名词卡片。
wondelai-skills.why_en: Bridges "read the book" and "use the book": each framework ships as a guided flow, not a flashcard.
